arcs.title: Breaking the Cage: Mile Marker 98, The Apex Trial & Engine Room Independence
arcs.subtitle: 1986–1999 • Holly's $1.00 Cross-License, Protocol T-10 & Owning Every Master
arcs.description: Follow the O'Connell siblings and Wright twins from their 1986 breakout through the black-ice crash at Mile Marker 98, seizing Exhibit A in Los Angeles, founding Engine Room Records, and building Ad Astra on their own terms.

arcs.description: Experience The Stardust Engine's return to the stage—from 95.5°F hydrotherapy in Blacksburg and standing beside Delegate Katie Prairie in Richmond to their seven-act stadium homecoming with the Marching Forgers.
